newsitem.title: USA: Avondale Financial closes sale of branch.
newsitem.headline: Avondale Financial closes sale of branch.

text.p: Avondale Financial Corp said Friday it will record a gain of about $1.9 million, or $0.50 a share, from the sale of a branch in Lake Forest, Illinois, to the First National Bank of Chicago, a unit of First Chicago NBD Corp.
Avondale said it complete the sale Friday. Specific financial terms of the transaction were not disclosed.
Avondale Financial is a financial services company with five traditional banking offices in the metropolitan Chicago area. The company has assets of $613 million.
